text: Tamar has a second interview with the council planning team on Thursday. She's nervous about the presentation part. Text her good luck Wednesday night.

Saskia's housewarming is Saturday, October 31st. She said bring nothing, but I'll take a plant anyway. She finally bought the terraced house in Headingley after losing out on two others this year, and she's doing a Halloween theme because of the date. Her partner Marcus is making his famous chilli. Starts at 7, and she said kids are welcome early on.
Marcus ran the Leeds half marathon on Sunday and got a personal best, 1:41. He's already eyeing the Manchester one in April.
Dinner at Tendai and Yara's place next Friday. They've just had the kitchen redone, so expect the full tour. Yara is vegan now.
Isaac didn't get the job at the architecture firm. He's pretty flat about it. I should take him for a pint this weekend.

Kevin's band is playing The Crescent on November 7. Tickets are ten pounds on the door. It's their first gig with the new drummer, and Kevin admitted he's been sleeping badly over it because the last one went so wrong. He asked if I could get a few people from work to come along and fill the room. I'll put it in the group chat tomorrow and see who bites.
Picked up the dry cleaning and booked the car in for its MOT on 11/3.
Mila's recital got moved from Tuesday to Thursday, 7pm at the music school. She's playing the Chopin nocturne she's been working on all summer. Her mum is flying in for it.
Anan mentioned he's applying for the senior data role at his company. Closing date is November 2nd. Don't forget to ask him how the application went.
Magda's fortieth birthday party has been called off because her dad is in hospital. She's going up to see him tomorrow. Need to check in with her over the weekend.
Aurelio Rossi, Aurelio to everyone except his gran, who calls him Lello. He supports Napoli and plays five-a-side on Mondays.
Abigail's daughter has her first ballet show on December 5th. Abigail is making all the costumes herself and is slightly losing her mind.
Sean got the job! He starts at the hospital trust on November 16th. Send him a congratulations card.
Zhang and his wife are hosting a Diwali dinner on the 8th, even though neither of them celebrates it. Their neighbours roped them in. I said I'd do dessert.
Ivan has a phone interview with a fintech startup tomorrow at 10. He's never done a technical interview before and is worried about the coding test.
Oliver's leaving drinks are Friday after work at the Fox and Anchor. He's off to a job in Bristol.
Mabel told me her cat Biscuit went missing last week and turned up three days later in a neighbour's shed. She's still a bit shaken.
Must RSVP to Alana's engagement party by Monday. It's on 11/21 at her parents' house.
Eilidh's choir has a competition in Glasgow next weekend. She's a soprano and has the solo in the second piece. Her husband Owen is driving them up on Friday.
Ana mentioned she hates surprise parties. Good to know before December.

Chloe's play opens on Wednesday and runs until the 14th. She plays the landlady, which is a much bigger part than she had in the spring production, and she's been rehearsing four nights a week since August. Her mum and dad are coming down for opening night. Remember to book tickets for the Saturday matinee, and maybe get her flowers to take backstage afterwards.

Owen called after his interview this morning. He said the panel was four people and they grilled him on budgets for twenty minutes, which he hadn't prepared for at all. The rest went fine, he thinks, and he liked the team. He hears back by the end of next week. His wife Siobhan is convinced he's got it, but he's not so sure.
Siobhan is coeliac, so if we do the dinner at mine on Saturday I need to sort a gluten-free main.
Joy's son Amir has his grade 5 piano exam on November 12th. Joy says he practises more than she ever did.
Leah and her partner have a gig at the Jazz Café in a fortnight. They do a duo set, her on vocals and him on double bass. I'm going with Aaliyah.
Aaliyah got through to the final round at Deloitte. Final interview is next Tuesday, in person in London. She's nervous but sounds well prepared.
Anil's brother Kevin is getting married on June 6th in Leicester. Anil is best man and already panicking about the speech.

Ilse invited me to her book club's Christmas dinner on 12/10. I'm going. Everyone brings a wrapped secondhand book for a swap, so I need to dig something decent out of the shelves. It's at Magda's flat this year, and Ilse warned me Magda's dog is enormous but friendly. Bring something to drink as well.
Krisztina's dad had his hip replacement on Monday and is home already. She's doing most of the caring and is shattered. Ring her on Sunday.
Haircut Thursday at 5:30, then gym. Groceries before the weekend.
Tamar said she'd heard nothing back from the council yet, two weeks after the interview. She's trying not to get her hopes up. I should check in with her next Monday.
Saskia's brother Owen is running the Berlin marathon next year. She's going over to watch and wants me to come along.

Marcus mentioned his boss is retiring at Christmas, and he's thinking about applying for her job. He hasn't decided yet. If he goes for it, the applications open in mid-November. Worth asking him about it when I see him at Kevin's on Saturday.

Tendai's cup final is this Sunday at 2pm. His team hasn't won it in eleven years, and he's captain this season, so he's feeling the pressure. His knee has been playing up since the semi, but the physio cleared him on Monday. His kids are making a banner. Text him good luck Saturday evening, and ask how it went on Sunday night.
Yara wants one of those big ceramic fruit bowls from the market on Kirkgate. Could be a good Christmas present.
Isaac's dog Pepper had an operation on her leg yesterday. He's taking a few days off work to look after her.
Kevin is having a few people round on Saturday to watch the boxing. I'm bringing beers.

Mila got into the Royal Northern College of Music! She auditioned back in March and had pretty much given up hope after hearing nothing for months. Her teacher Mrs Haddad cried when she told her. She starts in September and is already looking at flats in Manchester with her friend Alana. Must send flowers, and maybe arrange dinner before she goes.
Lunch with Anan today. His sister Joy is expecting her first baby in February and he's thrilled about being an uncle. He also said he's finally moving out of the flat share on the 28th.

Magda told me she's started applying for jobs outside teaching. She has an interview at a museum on November 4th, education officer role. She's anxious about it because it's her first interview in twelve years. Don't forget to message her the night before, and then again that afternoon to see how it went.
Aurelio and his girlfriend Chloe are throwing a joint birthday party on Friday the 13th. Fancy dress, horror theme.
Abigail's mum passed away on Sunday. The funeral is next Thursday. I need to send a card and ask if she needs anything.
Sean mentioned he plays cello in an amateur orchestra. Concert is in the spring, date tbc.
Zhang's interview at the university went well, he thinks. They said they'd let him know by Friday. Ask him on Friday afternoon how it went.
Ivan said the technical test was a disaster, but they still invited him back for a second round on November 3rd.
Oliver's wedding has been called off. He and Krisztina split up last month. He's staying with his brother for now. I should give him a ring this week.
Mabel turns 70 on 11/18. Her daughter is organising a lunch at the Italian place on the high street on the Sunday after. Mabel loves gardening, so maybe a voucher for the garden centre.
Alana got the promotion to head of marketing. She starts the new role on January 4th. Her team is taking her out next Wednesday.
Eilidh said the choir came second in the competition. She was thrilled with her solo.
Dentist appointment moved to November 9th. Need to remember to email work about it.
Ana's flamenco class is doing a showcase on Sunday evening. She's been dancing for three years now. She says she's terrified. I'm going with Joy and Leah.
Chloe is allergic to nuts, and her husband Isaac Gonzalez is vegetarian. Worth remembering for the dinner party.
Owen got the job! He starts at the council on December 1st. Yesterday was the call. We're celebrating at the pub on Saturday.
Siobhan's son Oliver is starting nursery on Monday. She's more nervous about it than he is.

Got invited to Joy's 50th surprise party on November 28th. Her husband Marcus is organising it and wants everyone to chip in for a weekend away for her. Send him twenty quid by Friday. Don't mention anything to Joy.

Amir has been unemployed since the summer and is finding it really hard. He has an interview at a bank on Wednesday, the first one in months. He wants to do a mock interview with me on Monday evening. I said yes. Should text him on Tuesday too, just to keep his spirits up.
Leah's flat viewing in Shoreditch is tomorrow at noon. She's been looking for months.

Aaliyah said the Deloitte final went well, but she won't hear until next week. In the meantime she's going to her cousin's wedding in Lagos on 11/14 and won't be back until the 23rd. She said she'd message me as soon as she hears. Note to self: if I haven't heard by the 25th, text her.
Anil mentioned his partner Ilse is running her first 10k on Sunday. She has a dodgy knee, so she's a bit worried about it. He's going to be at the finish line with their kids.

Krisztina's quiz team won the pub league last night. Twelve weeks unbeaten. They're having a celebratory dinner next Friday and she invited me. Uncle Ivan is coming over from Budapest for it too, apparently.
